responsibility: Provides Linux-specific rs6000 target hook implementations that are too small to live in the generic backend. In this version its main responsibility is implementing TARGET_FLOAT_EXCEPTIONS_ROUNDING_SUPPORTED_P for PowerPC Linux by reporting whether the selected libc/float configuration supports software or hardware floating-point exception and rounding-mode control, thereby feeding target capability decisions used by middle-end and front-end floating-point semantics.
